mcq_fix.s: According to recent estimates, India holds the world's ______ largest coal reserves.
mcq_fix.why: odd wording 'in the current estimate referred to'

mcq_drop.why: ambiguous: Bikaner/Rajkot only proposed, so 'associated with Phase II' can be read either way
oddly worded options ('mentioned in the assessment'), source-dependent

patterns: APPSC asks this topic as plain one-liners: core challenge of oil consumption (supply-chain disruption + price volatility), with silly distractors.
Methanol Economy aims asked as 'all three' list items (APPSC-G1 2024); Hydrocarbon Vision 2025 linked to storage of petroleum products (UPPSC).
Rank-type items ('India is the ___ largest') are the APPSC favourite shape; many filed PYQs are rank items from other topics.
AP tilt likely via Visakhapatnam SPR, KG Basin and IIPE.
App MCQs lean on 2026 month-specific data (July crude bill, Hormuz closure) and long multi-statement items, deeper than PYQ depth.
